ai_overview.summary: NOIM is compulsory under the Marriage Act 1961; lodge at least 1 month and up to 18 months before; parties 18+, not married, not prohibited; witnessed by authorised person (celebrant, JP, doctor, lawyer, police officer); documents: passport or birth certificate plus photo ID, evidence of end of previous marriage, accredited translations (per AI Overview, unverified).
